ios.desc:
Ever wonder what the world’s favorite really is? The best car, the most beautiful building, the cutest dog?
Elorate lets you find out — and have your say.

It’s a social ranking and discovery app where everything competes for the top spot.
Swipe or tap to choose your favorites, and watch how opinions from around the world shape what rises to the top. Each choice influences the live rankings — showing what people truly love right now.

From cars and architecture to food, perfumes, places, and more, Elorate is your window into global taste.

You can:
•  Rank anything or add your own items
•  Vote in direct comparisons that build live rankings
•  Comment, discuss, and debate your favorite topics
•  Discover what’s trending across every category and hashtag
•  See how your opinions compare with the world

Elorate isn’t just about rating — it’s about curiosity, discovery, and connection through what we love.
Join now and help define what deserves to be on top.

Discover. Vote. Rank. Discuss. Repeat.

show_hn.title: Show HN: Elorate- social app to rate anything

quotes.text:
I wanted to create a platform that can universally rate anything imaginable (movies, books, art, architecture, colors, clothing, fonts, programming languages so on and so forth). 
The idea is simple- a platform thats not bound by category (such as imdb/Rt for movies)- on Elorate each hashtag is a category and every posted thing is rated globally and within one specific category. To make it more sticky I've added a feature to rate things in Swipe Rate mode (tinder style) or pick one of two shown things- a "Pick one" mode.

As its meant to be rating+social media platform a feature to compare users tastes is coming soon.

iOS https://apps.apple.com/es/app/elorate/id6749582531

Android https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.elorate
